remarks: Welcome to one of the most sought-after communities in the City of Torrance, The Spencer Estates. This is the best community West Torrance has to offer! Enjoy 2,188 square feet through 4 levels of living space including 2 large bedrooms, 2.5 baths, and a large finished bonus room that can easily be used as an extra guest bedroom, office, home-gym, or a man cave on the ground level. This spectacular home also offers a sizable loft attached to the spacious primary bedroom. In addition to the flooring having been replaced all throughout, the main level is truly built for entertaining. There are three french doors on the main level that open to a spacious balcony overlooking the gorgeous Spence
